faqs.q: Sec. 94-62. - General requirements for street construction.
faqs.a:
All streets shall be constructed to the minimum cross section standards prescribed
               by the city. Construction type, vertical and horizontal curves, grades, pavement and
               base thickness and other construction details will be as per city standards and sound
               engineering practice.
(Code 1981, § 30-47; Ord. No. 1432, § 11, 3-6-1978)
